questions.question: 一共有多少位客户？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

questions.question: 有多少种商品？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products

questions.question: 一共有多少笔订单？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

questions.question: 有多少个商品分类？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories

questions.question: 有多少家物流公司？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shippers

questions.question: 评价数量是多少？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews

questions.question: 评级为5星的评价有多少条？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE rating=5

questions.question: 女性客户有多少位？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE gender='女'

questions.question: 商品的平均单价是多少？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM products

questions.question: 员工的平均工资是多少？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees

questions.question: 每个地区的客户数量是多少？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT r.name, COUNT(c.customer_id) FROM customers c JOIN regions r ON c.region_id=r.region_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY COUNT(c.customer_id) DESC

questions.question: 价格超过1000元的商品有哪些？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products WHERE unit_price>1000 ORDER BY unit_price DESC

questions.question: 已完成的订单有多少笔？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='已完成'

questions.question: 电子产品类的商品有多少个？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id=c.category_id WHERE c.name='电子产品'

questions.question: 每个商品分类的商品数量是多少？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.product_id) FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id=p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(p.product_id) DESC

questions.question: 消费总额排名前5的客户是谁？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: 每个地区的订单总金额是多少？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT r.name, SUM(o.total_amount) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id JOIN regions r ON c.region_id=r.region_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

questions.question: 评分最高的10个商品是哪些？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, AVG(r.rating) FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id=r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY AVG(r.rating) DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 每个部门有多少员工？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

questions.question: 各种支付方式的使用次数？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT pay_method, COUNT(*) FROM payments GROUP BY pay_method ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

questions.question: 每个会员等级的客户数量是多少？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT vip_level, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY vip_level ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

questions.question: 被取消的订单有多少笔？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='已取消'

questions.question: 销售额最高的商品前5名？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(od.unit_price*od.quantity*(1-od.discount)) FROM products p JOIN order_details od ON p.product_id=od.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY SUM(od.unit_price*od.quantity*(1-od.discount)) DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: 每种物流公司的订单数是多少？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(o.order_id) FROM shippers s JOIN orders o ON s.shipper_id=o.shipper_id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY COUNT(o.order_id) DESC

questions.question: 每个供应商供应的商品数量？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(p.product_id) FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id ORDER BY COUNT(p.product_id) DESC

questions.question: 各品类商品的销售额排名？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(od.unit_price*od.quantity*(1-od.discount)) FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id=p.category_id JOIN order_details od ON p.product_id=od.product_id GROUP BY c.category_id ORDER BY SUM(od.unit_price*od.quantity*(1-od.discount)) DESC

questions.question: 过去一年每月的订单量是多少？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date>=DATE('now','-1 year') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

questions.question: 消费最高的10个客户分别买了哪些品类？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(od.detail_id) FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id=p.category_id JOIN order_details od ON p.product_id=od.product_id WHERE od.order_id IN (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(total_amount) DESC LIMIT 10)) GROUP BY c.category_id ORDER BY COUNT(od.detail_id) DESC

questions.question: 比平均消费额高的客户住在哪些城市？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(o.total_amount) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING SUM(o.total_amount)>(SELECT AVG(total) FROM (SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id))

questions.question: 各评级的订单平均金额是多少？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT r.rating, AVG(o.total_amount) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON r.product_id=p.product_id JOIN order_details od ON p.product_id=od.product_id JOIN orders o ON od.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY r.rating ORDER BY r.rating

questions.question: 有多少位男性客户？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE gender='男'

questions.question: 金卡会员有多少人？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE vip_level='金卡'

questions.question: 退货表中有多少条退货记录？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns

questions.question: 物流公司有几家？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shippers

questions.question: 客户平均年龄是多少？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(age) FROM customers

questions.question: 最贵的10个商品是哪些？按价格从高到低
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 库存低于10的商品有哪些？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name, stock FROM products WHERE stock<10 ORDER BY stock

questions.question: 技术部有多少员工？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE department='技术部'

questions.question: 使用微信支付的订单有多少笔？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM payments WHERE pay_method='微信支付'

questions.question: 每个物流公司配送了多少订单？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(o.order_id) FROM shippers s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.shipper_id=o.shipper_id GROUP BY s.name

questions.question: 销售额最高的3个商品品类是哪些？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(od.unit_price*od.quantity*(1-od.discount)) FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id=p.category_id JOIN order_details od ON p.product_id=od.product_id GROUP BY c.category_id ORDER BY SUM(od.unit_price*od.quantity*(1-od.discount)) DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: 平均评分低于3分的商品有哪些？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, AVG(r.rating) FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id=r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id HAVING AVG(r.rating)<3

questions.question: 每个支付方式的订单数和总金额？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT pay_method, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE status='成功' GROUP BY pay_method

questions.question: 上月新增了多少客户？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE register_date>=DATE('now','-1 month')

questions.question: 没有评价的商品有多少？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reviews r WHERE r.product_id=p.product_id)

questions.question: 每个客户的平均订单金额？列出前10
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(o.total_amount) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY AVG(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 今年已完成订单的总金额？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status='已完成' AND order_date>=DATE('now','start of year')

questions.question: 被退货次数最多的5个商品？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(r.return_id) AS return_count FROM products p JOIN return_details rd ON p.product_id=rd.product_id JOIN returns r ON rd.return_id=r.return_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY return_count DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: 男女客户人数统计
questions.gold_sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY gender

questions.question: 各职级员工人数？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT title, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY title ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

questions.question: 华北地区的客户消费总额？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id JOIN regions r ON c.region_id=r.region_id WHERE r.name='华北'

questions.question: 每个供应商供应了多少种商品和多少类品类？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) AS category_count FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id ORDER BY product_count DESC

questions.question: 被搜索最多的10个关键词？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT keyword, COUNT(*) FROM search_logs GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 哪个仓库存储的商品种类最多？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT w.name, COUNT(DISTINCT wi.product_id) FROM warehouses w JOIN warehouse_inventory wi ON w.warehouse_id=wi.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT wi.product_id) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 使用过优惠券的客户有多少？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM coupon_usage

questions.question: 平均每笔订单包含几个商品？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(item_count) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS item_count FROM order_details GROUP BY order_id)

questions.question: 各评分等级的数量分布？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) FROM reviews GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating

questions.question: 各物流公司已签收率？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), SUM(CASE WHEN st.status='已签收' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM shippers s JOIN orders o ON s.shipper_id=o.shipper_id JOIN shipping_tracking st ON o.order_id=st.order_id GROUP BY s.name

questions.question: 价格高于品类均价的商品有哪些？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, p.unit_price FROM products p WHERE p.unit_price>(SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM products WHERE category_id=p.category_id) ORDER BY p.unit_price DESC

questions.question: 过去一年每个月的新增客户数和订单量？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', c.register_date) AS month, COUNT(c.customer_id), COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON strftime('%Y-%m', c.register_date)=strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) WHERE c.register_date>=DATE('now','-1 year') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
